license: SRTM is US public-domain data. Tile fetched from the public elevation-tiles-prod S3 bucket.
vertical_datum: EGM96 meters, orthometric. Not ellipsoidal height.
posting: 1 arc-second (about 31 m north-south and 28 m east-west at this latitude)
frame: Project each post with abu_samra.geo.local_xy. Do not assume square cells in meters.
mesh_recipe: For each row r in 0..rows-2 and col c in 0..cols-2, index i = r*cols+c. Triangles are (i, i+1, i+cols+1) and (i, i+cols+1, i+cols). Row 0 is the north edge. Position XY comes from latitude/longitude, Z from elevation_m.

known_reference.name: Abu Samra Border Post helipad
known_reference.note: Use this only as a sanity check. SRTM posting is 30 m and will not match a surveyed pad exactly.
